'''''Rhododendron indicum''''' is an [[azalea]] ''[[Rhododendron]]'' [[species]] native to [[Japan]] (S & W [[Honshu]], [[Shikoku]], [[Kyushu]], [[Yakushima]]).<ref>[http://www.rhododendron.org/descriptionS_new.asp?ID=113 American Rhododendron Society: Description of Rhododendron indicum]</ref>

==Taxonomy==
It is the [[type species]] for the ''Tsutsusi'' [[Rhododendron sect. Tsutsusi|section]] and [[Rhododendron subsect. Tsutsusi|subsection]], and was the original ''Tsutsusi'' described by [[Engelbert Kaempfer]] in Japan in 1712,<ref>"Tsutsusi" in Kaempfer, Amoen. Exot. Fasc.: t. 846. 1712</ref> from the Japanese name ''Kirishima-tsutsuji''.

== Cultivation ==
There are many cultivars,<ref>{{cite web|title=[Rhododendron indicum] nave rdictionary|url=http://terms.naver.com/entry.nhn?docId=771428&cid=46686&categoryId=46694|website=영산홍 (우리 생활 속의 나무, 2008. 3. 25.)}}</ref> including the [[Satsuki azalea|Satsuki azaleas]].
